acceptance_checks: With default python_files, running pytest from a directory containing foobar/__init__.py with an import-time failure and an unrelated matching test must not import foobar/__init__.py; the matching test runs successfully.
The same non-import behavior holds for pytest foobar when foobar/__init__.py does not match python_files.
A matching test file below a directory whose __init__.py does not match python_files is still recursively discovered and collected.
A regression test distinguishes eager discovery from indirect imports by using a package tree with no matching nested test that would normally import the package initializer.
Directly passing a package __init__.py preserves the existing default behavior of collecting no tests unless configured patterns allow them, without regressing existing direct-path tests.
With python_files = *.py or another pattern matching __init__.py, directory collection still imports/collects the initializer and runs tests defined there as covered by existing tests.
Existing collect_ignore behavior remains intact: ignored package trees do not have their initializers or child collection files imported.
The targeted collection test suite passes, including existing tests for initializer collection, direct initializer arguments, package traversal, pyargs/testpaths, and collect_ignore.
confirmed_decisions: Non-initial __init__.py files discovered during directory traversal are gated by the configured python_files patterns instead of being unconditionally treated as Package collectors.
The same pattern-gating applies when the containing package directory is explicitly passed to pytest.
Excluding a package initializer from eager collection does not exclude its directory tree; matching nested test files are still discovered recursively.
The fix prevents pytest's eager Package import only; it does not promise to suppress initializer execution caused by normal Python imports of nested test modules.
An explicitly passed __init__.py remains eligible for collection under existing initial-path semantics.
When python_files is broadened to match __init__.py, existing package-initializer collection and tests defined in __init__.py remain supported.
summary: Restore pattern-gated package discovery. During recursive collection—including the default current directory and explicitly supplied directories—pytest must not eagerly create/import a Package collector for an __init__.py that does not match python_files. It must continue recursively discovering matching test files beneath that directory. This guarantee covers only pytest's eager package discovery; importing a matching nested test may still execute the initializer through normal Python import semantics. Explicitly passed __init__.py files remain collectible, and configurations whose python_files patterns include __init__.py or *.py retain initializer/package collection behavior.
